sn54.11:1.1: Icchānaṅgala was a center east of Sāvatthī for the innovative brahmins of the Kosala region.
sn54.11:2.5: Given the consistency of this formula, it seems that the variations in the Buddha’s own meditation are meaningful and should be reflected in translation. These are the omission of _va_ (“just”) here; the omission of _vā_ (“or”) below; and the omission of _sikkhati_ (“one trains”).
sn54.11:3.2: Here we find “divine meditation” (_brahmavihāra_), which is normally associated with the four immeasurables.
